title: How much deposit you pay for the first home, explained with real numbers
seoTitle: First home apartment deposit: from 5%, with state guarantee
description: First home apartment deposit starts at 5% for homes up to 70,000 euros. The New Home program, figures verified on September 4, 2026, in brief.
descriptionLlm: First home apartment deposit starts at 5% for homes up to 70,000 euros. The New Home program, figures verified on September 4, 2026, in brief.
keywords: avans apartament prima casa, avans minim prima casa 2026, programul noua casa, avans credit ipotecar garantat de stat
lead: The program that answers the question of how much deposit is needed for the first home has carried the official name New Home since 2020. The name changed, the rules stayed the same, and in May 2026 the government approved its continuation with a fund of 500 million lei from which the state guarantees the loans. The mechanism in brief: the state guarantees part of the loan, and the bank accepts a deposit well below what it asks for in a classic mortgage loan. For a 60,000 euro apartment we are talking about 3,000 euros at entry, for one of 120,000 euros about 18,000. The difference between the two amounts comes from a single threshold of 70,000 euros, and below you take them one by one, with the exact sum for each.

blocks.x: Here the program is at its most generous. For homes of up to 70,000 euros, the minimum deposit is 5% of the price, and the state guarantees 50% of the loan. For a 60,000 euro apartment you bring 3,000 euros to the table, and the rest goes into the loan. The percentage is taken from the price entered in the contract, not from the sum you borrow from the bank. The state guarantee is the reason why the bank accepts a deposit it would refuse for other products.

sections.h2: Above 70,000 euros, the deposit climbs to 15%

blocks.x: New homes between 70,001 and 140,000 euros receive a different regime: a minimum deposit of 15% of the price and a state guarantee of up to 60%. The standard example: a new apartment of 120,000 euros, a deposit of 18,000 euros, and at the 140,000 threshold a 15% quota means 21,000 euros. From this level upwards, the advantage of the program no longer comes from the small deposit, but from the state guarantee and the capped interest rate. ## The old house has a lower ceiling than the new building

The ceiling moves depending on what you buy. An existing home enters the program up to 70,000 euros. A new apartment climbs up to 140,000, as does a house built from scratch or an energy efficient one. What exceeds the ceiling you pay out of pocket: you cover the difference with a larger deposit or with an additional standard loan, without the state guarantee. This is why you compare the price with the ceiling before booking, so you know from the beginning how much comes out of your savings. You have a useful reference in apartment prices, where you can quickly see which half of the table you are in.

sections.h2: The program runs only once, and the sale is made according to its rules

blocks.x: The benefit is a single one for life: if you have already taken a loan through First Home or New Home, you can no longer enter. The exception is the case where you have returned the state guarantee. After purchase, things move differently than with a classic loan: the guaranteed loan has restrictions on sale and rental, whereas with an ordinary mortgage you generally sell with the bank's agreement. On paper it is a detail; it matters on the day you think about moving to another city or making the switch to a larger apartment.

sections.h2: The program requires a home ready to live in, registered in the land book and energy efficient

blocks.x: The housing conditions are written in the program: completed and registered in the land book, with an energy efficiency certificate in class A, B or C. For the file you also sign a statutory declaration that you do not own another home larger than 50 square meters. So the rule targets the home you live in, and you check these papers before leaving a booking.

sections.h2: The interest follows the NBR index, but with a cap

blocks.x: At New Home the interest is variable and capped through the program: the bank limits its margin above the NBR reference index. For you, this means an installment that moves according to the index, but with a controlled maximum. We did not put an interest figure here: the index is recalculated quarterly, and any number written today is old after three months. What matters at signature remains the cap.

sections.h2: The developer asks for their money before you reach the bank

blocks.x: This is where people often get confused, so let us clear it up: the deposit from the program is the minimum sum you bring to the loan part, while the booking and the deposit from the contract with the developer are other payments, from own funds, in earlier stages. At Ilioara Residence, for instance, booking the apartment costs 2,000 euros plus VAT, and the developer asks for a minimum deposit of 30% of the price. The same person, two payment moments: the first money goes toward the builder, the loan part is discussed with the bank, where the state guarantee also enters. You can see the stages and prices on the apartments listed on the site.

faq.q: Can I enter the program if I already own an apartment?
faq.a: At the file submission you pass a statutory declaration, through which you state that you do not own another home larger than 50 square meters. Above this threshold, the program remains closed.

faq.q: What happens if the apartment exceeds the 140,000 euro ceiling?
faq.a: The program covers the sum up to the ceiling, and you pay the difference: you add it to the deposit or take it through an additional standard loan, without the state guarantee and with market interest. You reach the same principle with an existing home over 70,000 euros, where the ceiling drops. That is why the figure that matters at the start is not just the minimum deposit in the table, but the price of the home reported to the ceiling, because how much remains ahead from your savings depends on it.

faq.q: Do I pay a deposit both to the developer and to the bank?
faq.a: These are two different moments of the same purchase. The booking and the contract deposit go to the developer, from own funds; at Ilioara Residence, for instance, the booking costs 2,000 euros plus VAT, and the minimum deposit requested by the developer is 30%. The figures of 5% or 15% we talk about here are the minimums requested for the loan part, where the state guarantee also enters.
